issues.issue: The listed warnings (ILD/pneumonitis, hepatotoxicity, dermatologic reactions, bradycardia, hyperglycemia) are not supported by any of the provided citation quotes.
The characterization 'OS not statistically significant' is an interpretation not verbatim in the citation, though it is consistent with the cited HR 0.88 (95% CI 0.63, 1.23) crossing 1.0.
